theme_and_archetype.description: Authority, clarity, truth. Highly functional tracking UI with strong monochrome foundations. Color is used strictly for state indication and action, breaking the typical generic SaaS look by adopting an editorial, brutalist approach.

rules: 95% of the UI must be monochrome (White/Black/Grey).
Use Signal Green (#00A859) exclusively for positive delivery states or successful actions.
Use Safety Orange (#FF5B22) for 'waiting' or 'in-transit' active states.
Never use pure #000000; #0A0A0A is the default text color.
Tint greys slightly blue/cool to maintain the clinical authority of the logistics platform.
H1 (Hero/Main): text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter
H2 (Section): text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight
Body: text-base leading-relaxed font-normal
Overlines/Labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium
Numeric values (Wallet balances, Landmarks, Phones): Must use IBM Plex Sans for tabular, highly legible figures.
typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts (IBM Plex Sans) and Fontshare (Cabinet Grotesk)

rules: Use liberal padding for primary content screens: p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
Dashboard Layout: The 'Control Room' Grid - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 with tight gap-4.
Never center default text; left-align strictly for quick scanning and optical alignment.
Forms: 100% width inputs with crisp 1px borders, no soft shadows, hard rectangular corners.

surface_strategies.containers: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Containers use border-collapse style layout with 1px solid borders.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, NO soft shadows. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and solid black border.
surface_strategies.bottom_sheets: For tracking map overlays: Solid white background with a hard top border (border-t-2 border-black) instead of generic glassmorphism. It must feel like a reliable utility, not a social app.
surface_strategies.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Massive, chunky touch targets.

components_strategy.auth: Split screen on desktop. Left: Solid white form with stark typography. Right: Map background image heavily tinted (bg-black/50) to retain texture without distracting.
components_strategy.chat_create_package: Chat-style UI instead of a standard boring form. Sender messages are right-aligned (Black background, white text). System/bot prompts are left-aligned (Muted grey background, black text). Input anchored at the bottom.
components_strategy.package_tracking: State-driven: Full-bleed Leaflet map. Tracking status overlay in a stark white bottom sheet. Status indicators (Waiting, Assigned, Transit, Delivered) must use solid geometric indicators.
components_strategy.wallet: High-contrast digital display style. Massive typography for balance (text-5xl font-black). Buttons are full-width, solid block style.
components_strategy.receiver_view: Clear 'Accept' (Signal Green) and 'Reject' (Black) stark buttons. High-density information presentation for package details (landmark, item type).

rules: Minimalist animations. Snappy state changes rather than floaty transitions.
Use compound gestures for tracking lists.
Hover states must explicitly change text color or border color (e.g., hover:bg-black hover:text-white).

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, strictly un-styled except for active states.

rules: Never use placeholder image links.
Images must be properly cropped and fit the container.
Map backgrounds must have an overlay (bg-black/50 or higher) if text is present.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='accept-package-button').
